Fantastic Chinese BBQ in District 1
Jan 2026 • Friends
Hi Panda is a great spot for authentic Chinese BBQ skewers right in the heart of District 1. We ordered lamb, beef, and chicken skewers along with a few Sichuan dishes — everything was flavorful, well-seasoned, and grilled perfectly. The lamb skewers were especially memorable with bold cumin and chili notes.

Service was friendly and efficient, even though the place was busy, and the food came out quickly. The atmosphere is casual, lively, and comfortable, making it ideal for dinner or late-night eats.

Prices are reasonable for the area, and the value is excellent.
Highly recommended if you’re craving Chinese BBQ or spicy Sichuan flavors. I’d definitely return.

I visited Hi Panda for a friend dinner and was genuinely surprised by the quality of the food. the dishes have restaurant-level quality but come at very reasonable prices. Most importantly, the food was truly delicious.

As for the service, it was fairly average—nothing particularly outstanding, but still acceptable. The restaurant’s atmosphere is quite simple, not overly elaborate or distinctive.

Overall, this is a dining spot worth trying and revisiting.
